## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very strong sector breadth alongside a major divergence in large-cap tech (multiple big names showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — signals mixed, so neutral stance; Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities and Consumer Discretionary and Technology are leading on 1W performance: Utilities—VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Discretionary—F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND; Technology—QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials is the lone weak sector and Industrials and Consumer Staples show notable pockets of weakness: Materials—DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND; Industrials—DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples—WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -6.54%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.88% | 1M: -0.37%) RECOVERY, F (1W: +11.42% | 1M: +21.14%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for major divergence in big-cap tech—NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION — tactical volatility, not clear trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology shows strong winners but notable short-term pullbacks; QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +10.24% | 1M: +53.12%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +13.01%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: +3.08% | 1M: +15.98% (24 stocks) — breadth positive within the context of mixed leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing selective strength and rotation into cyclicals: JPM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -1.70%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +1.91% | 1M: +0.17% (20 stocks) — supportive but not uniformly strong.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is constructive with clear leaders on positive news: LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +9.56%) CORRECTION shows short-term fatigue. Sector 1W: +3.35% | 1M: +1.72% (17 stocks) — overall positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay balanced given NEUTRAL regime; favor areas showing confirmed above-trend strength (select Technology winners QCOM, AMD and cyclical Consumer Discretionary F/ROST) and select Financials exposure while reducing exposure to names showing structural weakness or extreme short-term declines (INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND — catalysts and price momentum to monitor. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION — risk of further downside or consolidation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Consumer Discretionary (both strong 1W performers) and pockets of Technology leadership. BEARISH: Materials (only sector negative) and select Industrials names showing breakdown risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — needs weekly stabilization to resolve pullback; monitor QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent breakout; watch INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND for continuation of selling that would increase sector downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+70): Eli Lilly positive Phase 3 obesity results — LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. MRK (+65): positive trial readout — MRK (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +6.80%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. IBM (+60): quantum/AI catalyst — IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+65): strong earnings narrative but NVDA (1W: -4.43% | 1M: +7.86%) CORRECTION — sentiment bullish but price showing short-term divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-55): headline-driven collapse — INTU (1W: -18.59% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (-80): talc verdict headlines are counter to trend — JNJ (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging and a risk to monitor. SBUX (-50): negative press on strategy — SBUX (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +4.19%) CORRECTION, sentiment aligned with short-term weakness. TTWO (-50): cautious outlook — TTWO (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION, sentiment confirmed by price pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. QCOM (1W: +18.20% | 1M: +77.80%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +10.66%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major tech divergence (NVDA, GOOGL, INTU) and sentiment/price mismatches (JNJ, NVDA) — watch for trend confirmation before shifting positioning.
